# France — History & Culture Overview

France shaped modern Europe through revolution, enlightenment, and empire. Paris set the pace for art, fashion, gastronomy, and political thought for centuries.

Outside Paris, France divides into culturally distinct regions: Alsace and Lorraine with Germanic influence, Provence with Mediterranean warmth, Brittany with Celtic roots, and the southwest with Roman heritage. The French value heritage, terroir, and intellectual debate as national virtues.
